title: ProvPerson
description: Rootless shape facet — PROV Person agent type: "Person agents are people." One of the three agent types PROV defines for interoperability. PROV defines no attributes specific to Person. Source: W3C PROV-DM (REC-prov-dm-20130430) §5.3.1 Agent, prov:Person; PROV-O prov:Person.

id.description: Identifier for the person agent — mandatory per PROV-DM §5.7.1; a qualified name, mappable to an IRI (§5.7.5).
